definitions.explanation: The act of creating original artistic or literary works; original creative output.
Something made up or invented; not based on fact.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{創作|そうさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{励|はげ}んでいる→励む：11822_hagemu⟧。
examples.english: I'm working hard on writing novels.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦シェフ→シェフ：05062_shefu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{創作|そうさく}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This dish is the chef's original creation.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{創作|そうさく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: That story is fiction, not fact.

examples.japanese: {創作|そうさく}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to a restaurant that serves creative cuisine.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{創作|そうさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混|ま}じっている→混じる：02421_majiru⟧。
examples.english: That article has some fabrication mixed in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧{創作|そうさく}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: His excuses were all made up.

notes:
{創作|そうさく} emphasizes original creation, particularly in artistic contexts. It can also mean something fabricated or fictional.

COMPOUNDS:
- {創作|そうさく}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: creative activities
- {創作|そうさく}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: creative cuisine, fusion cooking
- {創作|そうさく}⟦ダンス→ダンス：03856_dansu⟧: creative dance
- {創作|そうさく}⟦{意欲|いよく}→意欲：05317_iyoku⟧: creative motivation

USAGE:
- Literature: writing original fiction/poetry
- Art: creating original artwork
- Cooking: creating original dishes
- Dance/Music: original choreography/compositions

VS. OTHER 'CREATION' WORDS:
- ⟦{制作|せいさく}→制作：04320_seisaku⟧: production (of media, art)
- ⟦{製作|せいさく}→製作：04322_seisaku⟧: manufacture (of goods)
- {創作|そうさく}: original creation (emphasis on originality)
